name: autter-runtime
description: Open-source lightweight runtime telemetry: tiny browser error tracking, server OpenTelemetry, one OTLP ingester

scripts.build: npm run build -w @autter/runtime-core && npm run build -w @autter/runtime-node -w @autter/runtime-edge -w @autter/runtime-browser -w @autter/otlp-ingester && npm run build -w @autter/runtime-next
